text: Foundations for the gas turbine, steam turbine, generators and other rotating equipment above 500 kW (boiler feed pumps, CW pumps, condensate pumps, compressors) shall be designed per ACI 351.3R and the OEM foundation requirements. The gas turbine, generator and steam turbine foundations shall be table-top or block foundations on piles or improved ground, separated from building foundations and floors by isolation joints (ER-13.01).
